fonts.display: 'EB Garamond', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Deep Dusk
palette.role: Gradient terminal stop, button shadow depth — dark indigo that anchors the primary blue toward night

palette.name: Azure Crest
palette.role: Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Hover Glow
palette.role: Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Maximum-emphasis text, logo wordmark, icon fills — true black for highest hierarchy

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Primary body and heading text — near-black with slight warmth, softer than pure black for long reading

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Navigation text, icon strokes, secondary headings — dark cool gray for nav and structural elements

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Muted body text, helper text — medium gray for supporting copy

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Tertiary text, captions, disabled states — lighter gray for de-emphasized content

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Icon strokes (most frequent use at 56 stroke instances), placeholder icons, secondary strokes — the workhorse cool-gray for line work

palette.name: Vapor
palette.role: Card surface tint, body background alternates, subtle elevation base — cool off-white for layered surfaces

palette.name: Frost
palette.role: Tinted card background, hero-adjacent surfaces — barely-blue white that whispers atmospheric color

palette.name: Chalk
palette.role: Primary card surface, page background, button text — pure white for max-brightness layers

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Hairline borders (2500+ instances), dividers, input borders, icon borders — the dominant structural line color

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Secondary borders, separator lines — slightly darker than Bone for tiered dividers

palette.name: Neon
palette.role: Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

palette.name: Cyan Veil
palette.role: Subtle highlight wash, code-block tints, decorative gradient stop — cool cyan as atmospheric detail
